Subject: Renewal uplift proposal + soft-throttle alignment

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the productive renewal discussion yesterday. Based on your usage patterns over the last 6 months and the traffic spikes you called out on peak shopping days, I put together a staged uplift proposal that should give you predictable per-token economics while preserving a small burst window for marketing events.

High-level:
- Monthly commit: move from 800M tokens -> 1.6B tokens month 1, 2.4B tokens month 4 (staged over the 12-month term).
- Rate bands: guaranteed baseline throughput for the pledged commit with a soft-throttle grace of 2x baseline for up to 48 hours per month (non-guaranteed).
- Burst credits: 150M tokens per heavy-event quarter, billed at committed rate until burst threshold exhausted.

Attached is a short one-pager (Uplift_Term_Summary.pdf) and a draft SOW with milestones for rollout. Key asks from your side to move forward:
1) Confirmation on the staged uplift cadence (immediate vs. deferred start).
2) Any procurement windows or PO deadlines we should align to.
3) Which accounts team contact will own billing acceptance and legal redlines.

If agreeable, I propose a 30-min call early next week to lock the cadence and hand off to Laura for billing and Rishi for legal.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Markus / team — quick note from infra: we can support regionally applied soft-throttle windows, but they count against the same global burst budget unless we create isolated regional burst pools. Practical options: 

Option A (simple): single global burst budget (default) with regional prioritization during enforcement.
Option B (preferred for ClearStream): provision regional burst pools (US + EU) — increases operational overhead and requires a short deployment window to partition caches and routing.

If ClearStream needs guaranteed per-region SLOs during bursts, recommend Option B. We should outline the operational lead time (2–3 weeks) and any incremental costs. Laura — can you add an estimate to the priced-tier-sheet?

-Hannah

Asha — thanks for the questions and for aligning procurement. Quick summary of what we can commit to before our Thursday call: 
- Soft-throttle can be per-region (Option B) if you sign the staged uplift and accept a 2–3 week partitioning window. We'll reflect the regional burst pools in the final SOW.
- Early acceleration: we can add a clause to trigger the month-4 uplift earlier if you exceed 90% of month-3 committed usage for two consecutive weeks — we will require notice and a brief operational readiness check.
- Net-45: we can support net-45 for standard renewals; for quarterly prepay we can offer a 3% unit-rate improvement on committed tokens.

Next steps:
1) I'll update the SOW and priced-tier-sheet with the regional burst option and the early-acceleration clause and share an updated package (expected Wed EOD).
2) Laura to produce a billing worksheet showing quarterly prepay vs net-45 economics.
3) Legal (Rishi) to review burst-credit language and any PO terms.

I'd still like to hold Thu 09:30 PST to walk through the revised package — does that still work for you? If so, I'll send a calendar invite.
